scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.config.ts
scripts.test: vitest run --config vite.config.ts && python -m unittest tools/test_esri_gateway.py
scripts.format: prettier --write app/src app/index.html schemas tools/validate_dist.mjs package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts eslint.config.mjs MODEL_REGISTRY.json RELEASE_STATUS.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check app/src app/index.html schemas tools/validate_dist.mjs package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts eslint.config.mjs MODEL_REGISTRY.json RELEASE_STATUS.json
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run validate:registries && npm run build && npm run validate:dist
